items.title: Lenny's Podcast
items.summary: Lenny’s Podcast is a practical interview series where experienced product, growth, design, and technology leaders share actionable lessons for building products and leading teams.
items.author: Joseph Hill
items.body:
## Why it is worth listening

The conversations turn real-world experience from leaders at companies such as Anthropic, Netflix, Notion, Instagram, and OpenAI into practical guidance on product strategy, customer discovery, growth, influence, hiring, team design, and AI-era product development.

## Best for

Product managers, product leaders, founders, growth professionals, and designers who want candid examples, repeatable frameworks, and insight into how high-performing technology teams make decisions.

## Key takeaway

As AI makes products faster and cheaper to build, a PM’s advantage increasingly comes from judgment—knowing which problems matter, developing strong product taste, and aligning people around the right decisions.
